file_id: Syed Shamsuddin vs Sri Venkateswarlu, S-O Not Known, Age ... on 7 March, 2025

sentences.text: Syed Shamsuddin vs Sri Venkateswarlu, S/O Not Known, Age ...

on 7 March, 2025
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice J. Sreenivas Rao
 Contempt Case No.673 of 2011
Order:
This Contempt Case is filed invoking the provisions under Sections 10 to 12 of Contempt of Courts
Act to punish the respondents for willful and deliberate disobedience of the order passed by this
Cour

2. Heard Sri Sainath Reddy, learned counsel representing Sri S.Surender Reddy, learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition.
3.

Petitioners have filed W.P.No.29177 of 2010, seeking direction to determine and pay the compensation basing on the existing market value and this Court on 29.11.2010 granted interim direction as prayed for.

Respondent No.2- Revenue Divisional Officer has filed counter affidavit in the writ petition, wherein it is stated that the respondent authorities after following due process of law, laid down under the provisions of the National Highway Authority of India Act, 1988 passed award on 02.09.2018, and the petitioners have to approach the competent Civil Court, challenging the said award.

entities.text: National Highway Authority of India Act, 1988
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 4. In view of the same, this Court is of the considered view that no further adjudication is required in the contempt case.
Accordingly, the contempt case is closed.
However, petitioners are granted liberty to avail the remedies as available under law.
Pending miscellaneous petitions, if any, shall stand closed.
